description: One path rule (ADR 01192), through the real CLI: a relative path resolves against the source that set it. Each test runs one case of precedence.cjs, which sets up a folder under .tmp/fixture-precedence/, runs doc-detective there, and checks the exit code. A wrong base finds no file, so the inner run exits 2. No browser or network.

tests.description: A relative input in the project config resolves against its folder.
With relativePathBase: cwd, the project config's relative input resolves against the working directory.
A relative input in the user config resolves against the user config's folder, not the project config's.
A relative input in DOC_DETECTIVE_CONFIG resolves against the working directory, not the project config's folder.
A relative input in the deprecated DOC_DETECTIVE resolves against the working directory.
A relative --input resolves against the working directory.
A relative apiTokenFile in a config file resolves against its folder, not the working directory.
